nom: The INKEY List Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Sensitive skin is the most frequently named skin type; the great majority of reviewers, including several with acne-prone or reactive skin, report no irritation, redness, or breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with dry acne-prone skin, describe it as unusually hydrating for a cleanser, and one names it the most hydrating cleanser she has used.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report it controls oily areas without drying out the rest of the face.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report they still like the product, and one specifically notes it keeps her from feeling overly oily afterward.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, report fewer breakouts and clearer skin with continued use, though one reviewer who describes herself as more acne-prone did break out around her chin, clearing again within a couple of days.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe it as hydrating and non-stripping, though a handful, including one who combined it with other actives, report their skin felt dry, flaky, or tight afterward.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with a dermatologist-confirmed weak skin barrier, or barriers compromised by acne or retinol, report the cleanser is gentle enough to use while healing.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report reduced redness and irritation with the Centella-containing formula, alongside one who noticed slight redness after a few uses.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser controls shine without over-drying the rest of the face.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight gel that lathers into a light foam
Does not remove heavy or waterproof makeup on its own
Pump dispenser is convenient and controls product use
Bottle is smaller than expected for the price

extraits.texte: I bought this product, along with a few from The Ordinary, & they destroyed my skin. I used to have smooth, clear skin & after using these products; my skin is dry, flakey, & it BURNS when I used these products!

My experience with this product started when I saw the box. I honestly thought it was something for my spouse's 3D printer. I didn't care for the scent this product has. I am sensitive to smells. My skin felt dry. It was "clean" but seemed like it stripped my face too much. Might be a product for someone else. I received this product to review.

I received a sample of this product for free in exchange for a review. I really loved how lightweight the cleanser was, and the pump is a great add. I didn't find it overly drying and tight, and my skin did feel softer after the first use. I am more acne prone, so this did break me out around my chin, however that's more of my own sensitive skin than the product since it cleared it up within the next 2 days. Overall I would recommend this product

extraits.titre: Deep cleansing without drying your skin
extraits.texte: As a woman with dry, acne-prone skin, finding the right cleanser can often feel like an uphill battle. However, I recently tried The Inkey List Glycerin Gentle Purifying Cleanser, and I couldn't be happier with the results! From the first use, I appreciated how gentle this cleanser feels on my skin. It effectively removes makeup and impurities without stripping my skin of its natural moisture, which is crucial for my dry skin type. The glycerin in the formulation is a game-changer; it hydrates while cleansing, leaving my skin feeling soft and balanced rather than tight or dry. I also noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture and clarity. The gentle purifying action helps prevent breakouts without irritating my skin, which has been a common issue for me in the past. The only downside is it smells a little like shampoo

extraits.titre: Keeping this in my skincare routine!!!
extraits.texte: After a visit to my dermatologist and finding out my skin barrier on my face is extremely weak, I've been on the hunt to find a new gentle cleanser that focuses on improving the barrier and isn't harsh on my skin. I love this cleanser!! Just like it says, it's gentle (very) and leaves your skin feeling soft and smooth. I love it and am definitely keeping it in my daily skincare routine.

I have dry sensitive acne prone skin. Most cleansers leave my face uncomfortably dry and tight, this one did not. My face felt hydrated and had very little tightness. It caused no redness or irritation, or excess acne. It only lightly foams so don't expect lots of lather. Very little scent which is wonderful for those sensitive to fragrance, as I am.

As someone with PCOS, cleansers usually leave my skin either too greasy or dry/flaky. I was a bit skeptical this cleanser would work for me but was pleasantly surprised when my skin felt smooth and hydrated without being super greasy. If you have super sensitive, acne prone skin like me you should try this cleanser!!
